title: TAMIU introduces Tyler Unsicker as its new athletics director
excerpt: Texas A&M International University introduced Tyler Unsicker as its new director of athletics on Tuesday, Nov. 10, with a student-athlete-centered vision for Dustdevil Athletics.
content:
Texas A&M International University has a new leader for Dustdevil Athletics. The university officially introduced Tyler Unsicker as its new director of athletics during an introductory press conference on Tuesday, November 10, according to TAMIU Athletics.

University President Dr. Christopher Maynard joined Unsicker in addressing the university community, laying out a shared vision centered on growth, student-athlete development, academic excellence and competitive success. Maynard said he believes Unsicker is the right person to lead the program to greater heights, both on and off the field of competition, and pointed to a goal of competing at the highest levels of the Lone Star Conference while establishing TAMIU as a competitive force in NCAA Division II.

Unsicker, in his first public remarks in the role, described a student-athlete-centered approach to leadership, focused on preparation, personal development and a culture of continuous learning. He called college athletics a co-curricular experience that complements the classroom and teaches leadership, accountability, teamwork and perseverance — skills student-athletes carry well beyond their playing careers. He said he wants student-athletes to leave TAMIU with confidence, a degree, preparation to succeed in the real world and, hopefully, a championship ring.

Unsicker also reflected on his first evening in the job, when he attended a Student-Athlete Advisory Committee meeting. He said what stood out was the dedication and passion the student-athletes showed for serving the university and the Laredo community. During his introduction he also showcased his bilingual abilities, a nod to Laredo's culture and the relationships he hopes to build across the region.

As TAMIU Athletics enters this new era, Unsicker's leadership will focus on academic achievement, competitive excellence, community engagement and personal development — with success measured not only by victories, but by the lasting impact on the student-athletes, coaches and community the department serves.

Source: Texas A&M International University Athletics (godustdevils.com).
